style: Say firmly but kindly, like a county bridge inspector calling a load test.
lines: Press Go to send the pickup across. Or drag the truck onto the road.
Drag up from a joint to add a beam. Triangles hold their shape.
Those shaking joints are loose. Close a triangle with a beam.
Add a road beam.
The pickup made it across.
The school bus made it across.
The fire engine made it across.
The grain truck made it across.
The semi made it across.
A squeezed beam buckled.
A stretched beam snapped.
The cables went slack. A cable can pull but never push.
Each beam shows its hardest moment as the truck crosses. Tap Worst spots again for live forces.
Tick the promises your bridge must keep. The Yard scores them.
The yard is out of members. Erase one to add one.
Drag up from the table to build. Then press Shake or turn on the wind.
Drag the top sideways and let go to feel its sway.
A loose part folded. Connect it with a triangle.
It shook apart.
The wind pushed it over.
It rode out the shake.
The table shook at the tower's own sway speed. That is resonance.
Tap up to three designs to compare them. Tap Borrow to copy parts.
New inspection tag.
